plans.marketingTerms: * Like the flexibility of a variable price plan but worried the price may go up?  Lock in a price ceiling for the next year by adding Price Protection Guarantee to our Variable Select Plan.  You'll be billed at the Variable Select Plan rate, but your rate will be capped at today's price.  That means you will never pay more than $1.959 even if our price goes up.  But the best news is that if our price goes down, your price goes down too!  Price Protection Guarantee is only available with the Variable Select Price plan and is only $.99 per month-that's less than $12 a year for guaranteed protection against rising gas prices.  This is not a contract, but simply an additional service which you may cancel at any time without penalty.
plans.offerTerms: Price Protection Guarantee is a GNG Signature Service that is available with our standard variable price plan.  Our standard variable price plan does not require an agreement and the price per therm on this plan may change or remain the same each month based on market conditions.  However, with the Price Protection Guarantee service, your price per therm will not exceed today's price ceiling of $1.959 per therm for the next 12 months.  But if prices on our standard variable price plan drop, you will also enjoy the savings of lower prices.  The monthly GNG Signature Service Charge for Price Protection Guarantee is $.99 and you may terminate this service at any time without penalty.  This Signature Service will be discontinued if you change price plans or if your natural gas service is disconnected for nonpayment at any time during the term of your Price Protection Guarantee.  Do you have any questions before we continue?

plans.marketingTerms: Know your gas bill BEFORE you open it with GNG's Guaranteed Bill Plan! With this plan, you can lock in your monthly bill amount for a full year, regardless of fluctuations in weather or natural gas prices.  Your Guaranteed Bill will be customized for you and is based on several factors, such as prior gas usage at your premises and gas market prices, and it assumes normal weather conditions over the next 12 months.  To find out what your monthly bill could be, select this plan to see your quote.  You will not be fully enrolled until you place your order.  Let us help you take control of your natural gas bill!
plans.offerTerms: This is a flat bill plan which means that for the next year, you will be charged the same amount for each standard service period even if cold weather causes you to use more gas.  In the unlikely event your service period is outside the standard of 27 to 33 days, we will prorate your Guaranteed Bill Charge for that period.  Your Guaranteed Bill Charge includes your AGLC Base Charge, GNG Customer Service Charge and Gas Charge.  This amount does not include taxes or one-time charges such as connection or late charges.  If your agreement is cancelled during the first six months, an early termination charge of $150 may be assessed.  If cancelled during the last six months, an early termination charge of $75 may be assessed. For your convenience, at the end of your term, we will renew your agreement for another 12 months, subject to your continued eligibility. 45 days prior, we will notify you of your renewal options. Do you have any questions?
plans.externalTerms: With our Guaranteed Bill plan, your charge will be the same for an entire year, even if cold weather causes you to use more gas.  Simply set it and forget it! You will be billed the Guaranteed Bill Charge for all standard service periods during the 12-month term. In the unlikely event your service period is outside of the standard 27 to 33 days, we will prorate your Guaranteed Bill Charge for that period. Your Guaranteed Bill Charge includes your AGLC Base Charge, GNG Customer Service Charge and Gas Charge. This amount does not include taxes or one-time charges such as connection or late charges. A Flat Bill Early Termination Charge of $150 may be assessed if your agreement is canceled during the first six months and $75 if canceled during the last six months. For your convenience, at the end of your term, we will renew your agreement for another 12 months, subject to your continued eligibility. 45 days prior, we will notify you of your renewal options.

plans.marketingTerms: With Volume Discount, the more you use, the more you save!  This variable plan best suits those with larger heating needs.  Your first 74 therms will be billed at our Variable Select rate, currently $1.959.  After you reach a 74 therm threshold, your rate drops by at least 10 cents per therm for all remaining usage that month.  There's no contract, so you can change to any plan you'd like at any time.
plans.offerTerms: This plan does not require an agreement and the price per therm on this plan may change or remain the same each month based on market conditions.  Let me explain how you will be billed on our Volume Discount price plan.  Your usage will be billed in two tiers: 1-74 therms and 75+ therms.  The first tier is a variable price that is guaranteed to be no higher than GNG's standard variable price offer, our Variable Select plan.  The current price for tier 1 is $1.959.  The second tier is guaranteed to be at least ten cents less per therm than the first-tier price.  Do you have any questions before we continue?

plans.marketingTerms: GNG's Pre-Pay Guaranteed Bill Plan is a great option for anyone on a budget or has credit challenges and wants to have control over their gas bill. With this plan, you can lock in your monthly bill amount for a full year, regardless of fluctuations in weather or natural gas prices.  Your Pre-Pay Guaranteed Bill will be customized for you and is based on several factors, such as prior gas usage at your premises and gas market prices, and it assumes normal weather conditions over the next 12 months. No deposit is required for this plan, but an initial prepayment for your first month is needed before your service can begin. You can change to another price plan after 12 consecutive months of timely payments. To find out what your monthly bill could be, select this plan to see your quote.   You will not be fully enrolled until you place your order.  Let us help you take control of your natural gas bill!

An early termination charge of $150 may be assessed if you cancel during the first six months and $75 if canceled during the last six months. At the end of your term, your agreement renews for another 12 months, subject to your eligibility. 45 days prior, we will notify you of your options. plans.marketingTerms: Pre-Pay is a great option for anyone on a budget or who has credit challenges. Simply "pre-pay" each month for the expected cost of your gas service, and GNG will apply the difference to your bill the next month. This is a variable price plan where your price per therm may change or remain the same each month based on market conditions. No deposit is required for this plan, but an initial prepayment for your first month is needed before your service can begin. After the first 6 months on this plan, if, at this point, you have timely payment history, you'll receive a 5-cent per-therm discount on future bills for as long as you stay on this plan and maintain timely payment history. You can change to another price plan after 12 consecutive months of timely payments.
plans.offerTerms: Under the Pre-Pay plan, you pay in advance for your gas service and no deposit is required. Each month, we'll compare the amount you prepaid to your actual gas usage. If you used less than your prepayment, you'll get a credit. If you used more, you'll be charged for the difference. This is a variable plan, and the price per therm may change or stay the same each month based on market conditions. After the first 6 months on this plan, if, at this point, you have timely payment history, you'll receive a 5-cent per-therm discount on future bills for as long as you stay on this plan and maintain timely payment history. After 12 consecutive months of timely payment, you'll be eligible to change to another plan for which you qualify. On this plan, your service is subject to disconnection 5 days after the due date on your bill, if your bill becomes past due. Can I answer any questions before I take your payment?
